exposure: Kidney graft at time of pregnancy
cohort: The study included 41 patients with atypical hemolytic uremic syndrome (aHUS) who experienced 44 pregnancies and were enrolled in the Global aHUS Registry.
finding: Pregnancy is possible in women with aHUS, even those on dialysis or with a kidney graft, with careful monitoring for aHUS flares and prematurity, and prophylactic or therapeutic eculizumab offers disease control with a low risk of fetal abnormalities.
